description:
Advances: ancora.gate
Ready-for: investigate
Severity: Medium (found by the ancora-gg8.9 merge gate, 2026-09-05).
Review-bar-override: the fix is a design choice between describing the function in the spec and re-testing through the public path; not a patch.

Symptom: ancora-gg8.9 changed Ancora.Gate.gate_error/1 from defp to def so four clause tests could call it directly. mix spec.check --base e2fb6d2 reports ancora.derive derived/growth: tests now call new functions Ancora.Gate.gate_error/1. Against origin/main the finding is subsumed by the epic-wide ancora.derive spec edits, so CI is green, but no statement describes gate_error/1.
Why now: a production function made public for tests is exactly what derived/growth exists to catch. Options: (a) make it private again and cover the clauses through Gate.check with fixtures (three of the four worker cases already have subprocess tests); (b) describe the error-mapping contract in ancora.gate and keep it public.
title: Gate.gate_error/1 is public only so tests can call it
